info.title: Events API
info.description: Public API for managing event types

get.description: Returns all event types that the user has access to

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Filter event types by ownership scope. Use `personal` for event types owned by the authenticated user, or `team` for team event types.

get.description: Returns a single event type by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of event type

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of event type to update

delete.description: Deletes a single event type by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of event type to delete

post.description: Makes a copy of an event type. The copy gets the same settings, hosts, booking form fields, locations and notifications. Its name ends with "(Copy)" and its slug ends with "-copy".

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of event type to duplicate

get.description: Returns information about the currently authenticated user

put.description: Updates information about the currently authenticated user

get.description: Returns a paginated list of the authenticated user's contacts. Supports searching by name or email.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Filter contacts whose name or email contains this string.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page of results to return. Defaults to `1`.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: The number of contacts per page, between 1 and 100. Defaults to `15`.

post.description: Creates a contact for the authenticated user.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the contact

put.description: Updates a contact. Send only the fields you want to change.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the contact to update

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the contact to delete

get.description: Returns the webhooks registered by the authenticated user.

post.description: Registers a webhook. Novacal sends a signed POST request to the given URL whenever one of the subscribed events happens on an event you host or organize.

201.description: Webhook created. The response contains the signing secret used to verify deliveries.

get.description: Returns a single webhook by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the webhook

put.description: Updates a webhook. Use this to change the target URL, change the subscribed events, or pause deliveries by setting `is_active` to `false`.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the webhook to update

delete.description: Deletes a webhook. Novacal stops sending deliveries to it immediately.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the webhook to delete

get.description: Returns bookable slots for one of the authenticated user's event types. The event type's duration, slot interval, buffers and minimum scheduling notice are already applied, so every slot returned can be booked as is.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the event type to return slots for

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start date for the requested range

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End date for the requested range

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Optional IANA timezone used to convert returned slots. Defaults to UTC.

parameters.name: duration
parameters.description: Optional meeting length in minutes, for event types that offer a choice of durations. Defaults to the event type duration.

get.description: Returns availability ranges for one of the authenticated user's event types.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of event type

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start date for the requested range

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End date for the requested range

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: Optional IANA timezone used to convert returned availability ranges. Defaults to UTC.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of the events the authenticated user hosts or organizes. Results can be filtered by status and by date range.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter events by status. Use `active` for events that have not been canceled, or `canceled` for canceled events.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Only return events that end on or after this date. Accepts any parsable date or date-time value, for example `2026-07-01` or `2026-07-01 09:00:00`.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: Only return events that end on or before this date. Must be after `start`. Accepts any parsable date or date-time value.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The page of results to return. Defaults to `1`.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: The number of events per page, between 1 and 100. Defaults to `15`.

parameters.name: order_direction
parameters.description: Sort direction for the event start time. Defaults to `asc`.

post.description: Books a new event. This endpoint requires public API authentication. The authenticated token identifies the caller, while the booker is created from the submitted booking payload.

get.description: Returns a single event by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of event

put.description: Reschedules an existing event. This endpoint requires public API authentication.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of event to reschedule

put.description: Cancels an existing event. This endpoint requires public API authentication.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of event to cancel

get.description: Returns the availability schedules of the authenticated user.

post.description: Creates an availability schedule. The working days are derived from the weekdays you send hours for. A new schedule is not the default one, unless it is the first schedule on the account.

get.description: Returns a single availability schedule by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the availability schedule

put.description: Updates an availability schedule. The working days are derived from the weekdays you send hours for.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the availability schedule to update

requestBody.description: Availability fields to update. Partial updates are supported.

delete.description: Deletes an availability schedule. Event types that use it move to your default schedule. You cannot delete your only schedule.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the availability schedule to delete

post.description: Makes a copy of an availability schedule with a new name. The copy gets the same timezone and hours. The copy is never the default schedule.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the availability schedule to duplicate
